= context-variable-not-always-resolved-on-cypher-queries

== Setup

.Schema
[source,graphql,schema=true]
----
type Expr @node(labels: ["Exprlabel", "$context.tenant", "Resource"]) @mutation(operations: []) @limit(default: 100, max: 300) {
  """IRI"""
  iri: ID! @id @alias(property: "uri")
  realizationOf: Work @relationship(type: "realizationOf", direction: OUT)
}

type Work @node(labels: ["WorkLabel", "$context.tenant", "Resource"]) @mutation(operations: []) @limit(default: 100, max: 300) {
  """IRI"""
  iri: ID! @id @alias(property: "uri")
  hasResourceType: [ResourceType!]! @relationship(type: "hasResourceType", direction: OUT)
}

type ResourceType @mutation(operations: []) @limit(default: 1, max: 1000) @node {
  iri: ID! @id @alias(property: "uri")
}
----

.Test Data
[source,cypher,test-data=true]

CREATE(p1:Exprlabel:context:tenant:Resource:test {uri: "stuff"})
 CREATE (work:WorkLabel:test:Resource {uri: "another-stuff"})
 CREATE (resource:ResourceType {uri: "uri-to-be-found"})
 CREATE (p1)-[:realizationOf]->(work)-[:hasResourceType]->(resource)
----

== should be possible to target a node with dynamic labels in a filter

.GraphQL-Query
[source,graphql,request=true]
----
{
  exprs(
    where: {realizationOf: {hasResourceType_SOME: {iri_EQ: "uri-to-be-found"}}}
    limit: 1
  ) {
    iri
    realizationOf {
      iri
      hasResourceType {
        iri
      }
    }
  }
}

WHERE single(this0 IN [(this)-[:realizationOf]->(this0:WorkLabel:test:Resource) WHERE EXISTS {
    MATCH (this0)-[:hasResourceType]->(this1:ResourceType)
    WHERE this1.uri = $param0
} | 1] WHERE true)
WITH *

LIMIT $param1
CALL {
    WITH this
    MATCH (this)-[this2:realizationOf]->(this3:WorkLabel:test:Resource)
    CALL {
        WITH this3
        MATCH (this3)-[this4:hasResourceType]->(this5:ResourceType)
        WITH this5 { iri: this5.uri } AS this5

    }
    WITH this3 { iri: this3.uri, hasResourceType: var6 } AS this3

    RETURN head(collect(this3)) AS var7
}
RETURN this { iri: this.uri, realizationOf: var7 } AS this
